title: LimsArea
description: LimsArea is a plugin that allows users to create and manage specific private areas. Basically, it includes commands for operators, and by placing an Area Generator obtained through those commands, a private area can be provided to specific players.
body:
# **LimsArea Guide**
This plugin allows players to designate and protect their own private spaces from others. Within a protected area, unauthorized players are strictly prohibited from breaking or placing blocks and attacking entities.

![Area Example Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16e87747e33b6674a5b02380bfb8d0874cd10bc4_0.webp)

## Key Features
**Total Protection**: Keep your blocks and valuable entities safe within your designated boundaries.

**Customizable Dimensions**: You can freely adjust the radius and height to set the area size as you wish. (Maximum size limits may apply based on server configurations.)

**Convenient Management**: Manage your areas intuitively through dedicated items or a GUI menu rather than complex manual commands.

## How to Create an Area
1. **Admin Creation**: Administrators can use commands to immediately establish an area at a specific location.
2. **Area Generator Item**: By placing an 'Area Generator' item obtained from an admin, a protected zone is instantly created centered on the placement location.

Command Guide (Admin Only)
- /area check | Checks the owner of your current location and visually displays the area boundaries.
- /area manage | Opens the Management GUI to modify settings for the current area.
- /area reclaim | Removes your owned area and converts it back into an Area Generator item.
- /area delete | Immediately removes the area at your current location.
- /area give <radius> <height> | Grants yourself an Area Generator item with specific dimensions.
- /area create <radius> <height> | Instantly creates a protected area at your current location.
